entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: A decentralized order founded on Kamigawa to preserve nature and reverence for the kami.

entities.name: Shigeki
entities.description: The orochi who bonded with a nature kami, had a prophetic dream and founded the Order.

entities.name: Saiba Futurists
entities.description: Developers of the technique to draw energy from the spirit realm; despised by the Order.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: Rulers of Kamigawa under Kyodai who built merge gates.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Under whose auspices the Imperials governed.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War about 1,200 years before the Order was established.

entities.name: Sokenzanshi
entities.description: Home of akki artisans who created enhancers.

events.summary: The orochi Shigeki bonds with a nature kami, has a prophetic dream of the spirit realm shattering, and founds the Order of Jukai.
events.quote: When the orochi Shigeki bonded with a nature kami, he experienced a prophetic dream of the spirit realm shattering.

events.summary: The Order grows swiftly as others share the visions.
events.quote: The Order grew swiftly as others had similar visions of the spirit realm's destruction.

relations.quote: named his new Order after the moment when the Jukai forest expelled all mortals
They actively despise the Saiba Futurists and desire to destroy their floating headquarters.
